title: C¹ images are covered by an Hⁿ-null set and countably many embedded C¹ n-submanifolds
statement: For all n, p ∈ ℕ (ℝᵈ := EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) and every map G : ℝⁿ → ℝᵖ of class C¹ (ContDiff ℝ 1 G), there are a set N₀ ⊆ ℝᵖ with Hⁿ(N₀) = 0 (Hⁿ = μHE[n], applied as an outer measure) and sets N_k ⊆ ℝᵖ (k ∈ ℕ), each an n-dimensional embedded C¹ submanifold in the sense of IsC1Submanifold n, such that the range G(ℝⁿ) ⊆ N₀ ∪ ⋃_k N_k.
lean_statement: ∀ (n p : ℕ) (G : Rn n → Rn p), ContDiff ℝ 1 G → ∃ (N₀ : Set (Rn p)) (N : ℕ → Set (Rn p)), μHE[n] N₀ = 0 ∧ (∀ k, IsC1Submanifold n (N k)) ∧ Set.range G ⊆ N₀ ∪ ⋃ k, N k
